subject: health

location.unitTitle: Nutrition, Movement, Sleep, and Body Respect

instructions: Complete the private-safe task without disclosing medical history, diagnosis, body measurements, or sexual history.
Use a fictional scenario when offered and identify a trusted adult or qualified professional where appropriate.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain adequate and varied fueling in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of hydration.
Apply sleep cycles in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving movement and recovery; correct it and explain why.
Connect adequate and varied fueling with allergy and food-safety planning. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Design several flexible wellness routines without calorie targets, dieting, weight cutting, weigh-ins, or body comparison.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Nutrition, Movement, Sleep, and Body Respect?
